name: MEL01B (South)

address.note: STACK MEL01 page gives only 'Truganina'; 399 Palmers Rd per Baxtel (source 9), ITK Research and OSM building tags (source 8); datacenterHawk (source 2) not fetchable (403)

lat.note: geocoded: centroid of OSM building "Stack Infrastructure MEL01B", 399 Palmers Rd

builder.note: Hickory MEL01B page: 'Following the success of MEL01A' Hickory built the three-level South building for client STACK; topping-out news Nov 2024 (source 5). A.G. Coombs: building services for Stages 1 and 2 (source 11)

developer.note: campus originally developed by Hickory Data Centres; STACK owns/operates since 2022

mw_it.note: STACK MEL01 page: MEL01B 36MW, South building, 12 data halls across 3 levels, onsite substation with diverse feeders; Hickory pages (sources 4,5): 36MW critical capacity, three-level, air-cooled

mw_grid.note: campus-level onsite substation only (STACK: 66kV/11kV, 135MW; Hickory Aug 2023: 105MW)

authority.note: planning permit not found. Site in Wyndham City Council; earlier Wyndham application WYP12005/20 at 399 Palmers Rd (Dec 2019, warehouse). The Mar 2024 data centre application WYP14522/24 is at 369 Palmers Rd (the MEL01C/D parcel), not this building

construction_start.note: not found. STACK June 2022 release says 'two 36MW buildings (currently under construction)' (source 10) and A.G. Coombs describes concurrent construction on the adjacent parcel (source 11), but the Aug 2023 Hickory release calls the second 36MW 'the upcoming second 36MW development' (source 6). Topped out Nov 2024 (source 5)

construction_end.note: DCD Nov 2025: MEL01B construction completed (DCD page 403 - from search snippet); Baxtel (source 9, fetched) lists MEL01B as fully operational, built 2025. Hickory topping-out news dated 14 Nov 2024 (source 5). ITK's claim that A and B both received occupancy permits Aug 2023 is contradicted by the Aug 2023 Hickory release (only the first 36MW phase delivered)

open_questions: construction start date not found (2022 vs after Aug 2023 unclear)
